batch_node.name: FedRAMP 20x VDR dimensions v0.1.0
batch_node.description: Dimension nodes for every dimension key the fedramp_20x_vdr plugin writes, so each key has a declared node now that the dimension map is keyed by node id (tap#708, tap#711).

node.name: fedramp.rule
node.description: The FedRAMP rule family an object belongs to, so a filter can scope to one family without naming a type. This plugin writes the value vdr on every type and edge it owns; another rule family from the same regime takes its own value.

node.name: vdr.scheme
node.description: The algorithm or method that made a VDR evaluation: max for the VDR-max collector, another name for another method. Stamped on every vdr_evaluation and its EVALUATES_COMPLIANCE_FINDING edge as a copy of the node's scheme column, for display and filtering.
